svg.title: A meeting page in Inkwright
svg.desc: Handwritten meeting notes: acme, 40 reps; spreadsheets, hate it; security review?; price. Beneath each, Inkwright has written what was said, in blue AI ink with the time it was said: Dana runs sales ops in two regions (0:11); forecasts take two days a month (0:24); they tried Salesforce and the rollout stalled (0:41); the CFO Priya signs off and IT's review takes about three weeks (1:26); $24 per rep per month is within budget (2:02); and an action item, send the SOC 2 report today (2:30).
svg.text: Mon 10:00 · Dana Ross, Priya Shah · recorded 2:58
